newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SPORTING RUNNERS UP IN PORTUGUESE LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPORTING RUNNERS UP IN PORTUGUESE LEAGUE.

text.p: Sporting made sure of finishing second in the Portuguese league and gave them themselves a chance of qualifying for next season's European champions league by beating Salgueiros 3-0 away on Friday.
With three games still to play, league leaders Porto need just a point from Saturday's game against Guimaraes to clinch a record third successive title.
Benfica are third, 13 points behind Sporting but with one game in hand.
Sporting opened the score after 20 minutes when Moroccan midfielder Mustapha Hadji headed home a cross from Pedro Barbosa.
Defender Jose Vidigal made it 2-0 before halftime. The third goal came some 10 minutes from the end when 17-year-old Simao Sabroso connected with a fierce drive from just inside the area.
